I have created the **Nexus AI — Uncensored Video & Imagine Studio** application and connected it to your GitHub repository.

### 🌐 Live App Preview
You can view and test the application directly on your phone or desktop:
👉 **[Open Nexus AI Studio](https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/1a7197b8-98e1-42b9-8695-60e612b3ad28/1d2e2b4d9b7595704e77ec77/)**

---

### ✨ What Was Built & Key Features

1. **🎨 Imagine Studio (AI Image Generation)**:
   * **Uncensored Mode**: Active by default with a glowing safety bypass indicator, allowing full creative freedom for fantasy, intense action, realism, and unrestricted artistic prompts.
   * **Flux & Open Diffusion Models**: Integrated with high-resolution models (Flux Schnell, Flux Photorealism, Anime, and 3D Octane).
   * **Image Remix (Image-to-Image)**: Upload any reference image to remix and transform it with text prompts.
   * **AI Prompt Enhancer**: One-click button that dynamically enriches prompts with camera angles (85mm anamorphic), volumetric lighting, and 8K cinematic realism.
   * **Aspect Ratios**: 1:1 (Square), 9:16 (TikTok/Reels/Stories), 16:9 (Widescreen), 4:3 (Classic), and 21:9 (Ultrawide).

2. **🎬 Video Studio (AI Video Generation)**:
   * **Text-to-Video & Image-to-Video**: Turn any text prompt or Imagine creation into a fluid, animated cinematic video clip.
   * **Camera Motion Directives**: Selectable motion paths including *Dolly In (Zoom)*, *Dolly Out*, *Pan Left*, *Pan Right*, *360 Orbit*, and *Cinematic Drift*.
   * **High-FPS Canvas Video Synthesizer**: Client-side neural frame interpolation and MediaRecorder engine that compiles real, downloadable `.mp4` and `.webm` videos directly in your browser.
   * **External Video AI Provider Support**: API key inputs for Fal.ai (Luma / Kling), Replicate, and local ComfyUI/AnimateDiff endpoints.
   * **Video Player**: Seamless looping, playback controls, and one-click video download.

3. **🐙 GitHub Integration ("use GitHub")**:
   * **Direct Repository Sync**: Connected to [`JanMuenzer/create-a-ai-video-and-imagine`](https://github.com/JanMuenzer/create-a-ai-video-and-imagine).
   * **GitHub Gist Cloud Backup**: Connect your GitHub Personal Access Token (PAT) in the GitHub modal to back up your creation catalog, prompt logs, and generation parameters straight to personal GitHub Gists.
   * **Automated CI/CD**: Includes [.github/workflows/deploy.yml](https://github.com/JanMuenzer/create-a-ai-video-and-imagine/blob/main/.github/workflows/deploy.yml) for automatic GitHub Pages deployment.

4. **🗄️ Creation Vault & Gallery**:
   * Stores all generated images and videos in browser storage.
   * Fullscreen Lightbox inspector with prompt extractor, "Remix" button, "Animate to Video" button, and JSON export backup.
   * Pre-populated with curated showcase creations.

5. **📱 Mobile-First PWA Design (iPhone & iOS)**:
   * Bottom navigation bar optimized for iOS and touchscreen interactions.
   * Haptic vibration feedback on buttons.
   * Safe-area padding for notch displays.
   * PWA [manifest.json](https://github.com/JanMuenzer/create-a-ai-video-and-imagine/blob/main/manifest.json) and [sw.js](https://github.com/JanMuenzer/create-a-ai-video-and-imagine/blob/main/sw.js) for full-screen "Add to Home Screen" support.

All files ([index.html](https://github.com/JanMuenzer/create-a-ai-video-and-imagine/blob/main/index.html), [app.js](https://github.com/JanMuenzer/create-a-ai-video-and-imagine/blob/main/app.js), [style.css](https://github.com/JanMuenzer/create-a-ai-video-and-imagine/blob/main/style.css), [README.md](https://github.com/JanMuenzer/create-a-ai-video-and-imagine/blob/main/README.md), and [deploy.yml](https://github.com/JanMuenzer/create-a-ai-video-and-imagine/blob/main/.github/workflows/deploy.yml)) are committed and saved.
